2_wprod_gpu_kernel_exec_slowdown_s.mechanism: GPU SM / unified-memory sharing while concurrent prover CBs execute

3_wprod_host_encode_wakeup_overlapped_ro.mechanism: Begin-to-commit encode + GPUEnd-to-done wakeup + overlapped QR/KR RoPE in P1 (i16 pack, weight_buffer, and result_plane run before begin, inside P2/P4/P6/P8)

4_intra_block_host_gaps_p2_p4_p6_s.mechanism: Host contention on Apple M3 Ultra (32 cores: 8-thread SealPool vs 6 fork threads + global Rayon pool; 0 wprod CBs in flight; includes attention/norm_m/SwiGLU plus QKV requant/RoPE tail and Wo/Wg/Wu/Wd preludes)

5_inter_block_and_bookend_host_p8_s.mechanism: Host contention (cause not separated; internal split of P8 not measured: builder tail, assign_with plane alloc/zero/scatter, CS-3 lookup scan, padded_plane, handoff, next-block checks/weight scan, norm_a, QKV preludes; longer gaps coincide with host-heavy prover phases when prover GPU is idle)
